title: 'Ere We Go!
subtitle: Charge phase: declare, roll 2D6, get stuck in

bullets: Pick da chargin' unit, tick da target(s) in da list, den [b]Declare Charge[/b].
[b]Roll 2D6[/b] — dat's how far every model can move. Too short an' da charge fails.
A [b]Command Re-roll[/b] (1 CP) gets offered on da charge roll — take it if ya came up short.
[b]Snap to Contact[/b] shoves da whole mob into base contact; drag 'em yerself if ya want it tidy.
[b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] locks it. Chargin' units fight first next phase.
Next lesson: Krumpin' — da Fight phase.

prompt.text: Da Boyz shot 'em up — now dey wanna get stuck in. Chargin' is three steps: [b]declare[/b] who ya want, [b]roll[/b] 2D6, den [b]move[/b] into contact. Fail da roll an' dey don't move at all.

prompt.kbm: Click da [b]Boyz[/b] in da unit list, tick [b]Custodian Guard[/b] in da target list, den hit [b]Declare Charge[/b].
prompt.pad: Glide {ls} onto da [b]Boyz[/b] row, {a}. Tick [b]Custodian Guard[/b] wiv {a}, den [b]Declare Charge[/b].

hint.text: Ya can declare more dan one target — but every one of 'em gets to shoot Overwatch back.

prompt.kbm: Hit [b]Roll 2D6[/b]. Whatever ya roll is how many inches [i]every[/i] model in da mob gets — an' dey all gotta end up wivin engagement range for it to count.

hint.text: Da panel shows da rolled distance right after — dat's yer budget.

prompt.text: Nine inches — plenty. Da game offers a [b]Command Re-roll[/b] on any charge roll (1 CP) in case ya come up short; we don't need it. Click [b]Keep Roll[/b].

hint.text: Keep Roll — save da CP. Ya'd only re-roll if da charge fell short.

prompt.kbm: Now shift da mob. Drag each model — or just hit [b]Snap to Contact[/b] an' da whole lot piles into base contact. Da panel counts how many still need placin'.
prompt.pad: Press {a} on [b]Snap to Contact[/b] — or grab models one at a time wiv {a}, glide {ls}, {a} to drop.

hint.text: [b]Undo Last Model[/b] takes back one drop if ya put a boy somewhere daft.

prompt.kbm: Hit [b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] to finish da charge. Da mob's now [b]in engagement[/b] — an' chargin' units strike first in da Fight phase.
prompt.pad: Glide onto [b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] an' press {a}.

prompt.kbm: Da wagon an' da grots ain't chargin' today. Hit da big red button to end da Charge phase.
prompt.pad: Da wagon an' grots ain't chargin'. Press {menu} an' confirm to end da phase.
